title: Portfolio Selection
sr: Rođenje moderne teorije portfolija: diverzifikacija, odnos prinosa i rizika (varijanse) i efikasna granica.
en: The birth of modern portfolio theory: diversification, the mean-variance trade-off and the efficient frontier.

title: Capital Asset Prices: A Theory of Market Equilibrium under Conditions of Risk
sr: CAPM - očekivani prinos zavisi samo od sistematskog rizika (beta). Osnova za trošak kapitala i ocenu performansi.
en: CAPM - expected return depends only on systematic risk (beta). The basis for cost of capital and performance evaluation.

title: Efficient Capital Markets: A Review of Theory and Empirical Work
sr: Hipoteza efikasnog tržišta i njena tri oblika (slaba, polujaka, jaka). Polazna tačka svake rasprave o „pobeđivanju tržišta“.
en: The efficient market hypothesis and its weak, semi-strong and strong forms. The starting point of every 'beat the market' debate.

title: The Pricing of Options and Corporate Liabilities
sr: Black-Scholes formula za vrednovanje opcija - temelj tržišta derivata i kvantitativnih finansija.
en: The Black-Scholes option pricing formula - the foundation of derivatives markets and quantitative finance.

title: Theory of Rational Option Pricing
venue: Bell Journal of Economics and Management Science
sr: Uopštava vrednovanje opcija (dividende, promenljive kamatne stope) i formalizuje arbitražne granice cena.
en: Generalises option pricing (dividends, stochastic rates) and formalises no-arbitrage price bounds.

title: Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk
sr: Ljudi drugačije vrednuju gubitke i dobitke (averzija prema gubitku). Temelj bihevioralnih finansija.
en: People weigh losses and gains asymmetrically (loss aversion). The foundation of behavioural finance.

title: Do Stock Prices Move Too Much to be Justified by Subsequent Changes in Dividends?
sr: Cene akcija su volatilnije nego što dividende opravdavaju - ključni argument protiv čiste efikasnosti tržišta.
en: Stock prices are far more volatile than dividends justify - a key argument against pure market efficiency.

title: Autoregressive Conditional Heteroscedasticity with Estimates of the Variance of United Kingdom Inflation
sr: ARCH model - volatilnost se grupiše u vremenu. Osnova modelovanja rizika i VaR-a.
en: The ARCH model - volatility clusters over time. The basis of risk modelling and VaR.

title: Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity
sr: GARCH - najkorišćeniji model volatilnosti u praksi i dobar benchmark za ML modele prognoze.
en: GARCH - the most widely used volatility model in practice and a standard benchmark for ML forecasts.

title: A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle
sr: Modeli sa promenom režima (Markov switching) - tržišta se ponašaju drugačije u krizi i u rastu.
en: Regime-switching (Markov switching) models - markets behave differently in crises and expansions.

authors: Eugene F. Fama, Kenneth R. French
title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds
sr: Trofaktorski model (tržište, veličina, vrednost) - zamenio CAPM kao standard u empiriji.
en: The three-factor model (market, size, value) - replaced CAPM as the empirical standard.

title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers: Implications for Stock Market Efficiency
sr: Momentum efekat - akcije koje su rasle nastavljaju da rastu 3-12 meseci. Jedna od najpostojanijih anomalija.
en: The momentum effect - past winners keep outperforming for 3-12 months. One of the most persistent anomalies.

title: ANFIS: Adaptive-Network-Based Fuzzy Inference System
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
sr: Originalni ANFIS rad - spoj neuronskih mreža i fazi logike, osnova velikog dela literature o prognozi tržišta.
en: The original ANFIS paper - neural networks meet fuzzy logic; the basis of much market-forecasting literature.

title: On Persistence in Mutual Fund Performance
sr: Četvorofaktorski model (dodaje momentum) i dokaz da uspeh fondova uglavnom ne traje.
en: The four-factor model (adds momentum) and evidence that fund outperformance rarely persists.

authors: George S. Atsalakis, Kimon P. Valavanis
title: Surveying stock market forecasting techniques - Part II: Soft computing methods
sr: Pregled preko 100 radova o neuronskim mrežama i neuro-fazi modelima za prognozu tržišta - odličan ulaz u oblast.
en: A survey of 100+ papers on neural and neuro-fuzzy market forecasting - an excellent entry point to the field.

authors: Eugene F. Fama, Kenneth R. French
title: A five-factor asset pricing model
sr: Dodaje profitabilnost i investicije - današnji standardni faktorski model.
en: Adds profitability and investment factors - today's standard factor model.

authors: Campbell R. Harvey, Yan Liu, Heqing Zhu
title: ... and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
sr: Od stotina „otkrivenih“ faktora većina je verovatno lažna (data mining) - važan rad o metodologiji.
en: Most of the hundreds of 'discovered' factors are likely false positives - a key methodology paper.

title: Building Diversified Portfolios that Outperform Out of Sample
sr: Hierarchical Risk Parity - mašinsko učenje (klasterovanje) umesto nestabilne inverzije kovarijansne matrice.
en: Hierarchical Risk Parity - ML clustering instead of unstable covariance matrix inversion.

authors: J. B. Heaton, N. G. Polson, J. H. Witte
title: Deep learning for finance: deep portfolios
venue: Applied Stochastic Models in Business and Industry
sr: Rani, uticajan rad o primeni dubokog učenja na konstrukciju portfolija.
en: An early, influential paper applying deep learning to portfolio construction.

title: Deep learning with long short-term memory networks for financial market predictions
sr: LSTM mreže za predviđanje S&P 500 - jedan od najcitiranijih radova o dubokom učenju na tržištu akcija.
en: LSTM networks for S&P 500 prediction - one of the most cited deep-learning stock market papers.

authors: Shihao Gu, Bryan Kelly, Dacheng Xiu
title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
sr: Sistematsko poređenje ML metoda (stabla, neuronske mreže) za prinose akcija - referentni rad za ML u finansijama.
en: A systematic comparison of ML methods (trees, neural nets) for stock returns - the reference paper for ML in finance.

title: Can ChatGPT Forecast Stock Price Movements? Return Predictability and Large Language Models
sr: Pokazuje da veliki jezički modeli mogu da izvuku signal iz vesti - otvorio talas istraživanja LLM-ova u finansijama.
en: Shows LLMs can extract return signals from news headlines - kicked off the wave of LLM-in-finance research.
